equal_sandbox_detail.timing_energy_bars_source: reports/comparison/<vendor>/dpt_metrics.json#golden_metrics (spec 6 G4 fallback decision; emit=ann); README DPT timing and energy table

timing_energy_bars.source: reports/comparison/<vendor>/dpt_metrics.json#golden_metrics for emit=ann, #tier2_metrics for emit=tier2 (spec 6 fallback decision); README DPT timing and energy table

speed_n_pulses.rationale: 20 pulses is the pinned adaptive row; a 2-pulse default row must never be compared to it

speed_repeats.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 1.3 item 7 (at least 3 interleaved repeats)

dpt_trace_point_fraction.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 1.3 item 5 (at least 50 percent of golden points)

tuning_max_evals.rationale: bounded derivative-free search over four named fields; not an emitter default

tuning_bounds.rationale: O_GD is capped at one full Q_RSS at the top of the measured curve-4 sweep; Qoss is frozen and never used for this gate-side bound

timing_band.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 6 G4 (no worse than the recorded table); reports/comparison/<vendor>/dpt_metrics.json#golden_metrics (emit=ann) or #tier2_metrics (emit=tier2, spec 6 fallback decision)
timing_band.rationale: 5 percent band around each recorded timing/energy bar: a much smaller delay is not an improvement when the device never turns on; missing bars stay not_measured

zero_current_anchor.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 2.3 (VDS=0 and Vth cutoff guards); models/netlist_builder.py:_channel_expression
zero_current_anchor.rationale: 1 percent of the swept peak current is a structural G2 anchor tolerance, not a measured device current

tuning_golden_emp.rationale: golden metrics are cached once; completion uses recorded iterations, trace points and t_last. Non-completing conditions are never scored

tuning_candidate_libs.source: pipeline/tuning.py:make_dpt_simulator; spec section 5 (no permanent candidate artifacts)
tuning_candidate_libs.rationale: candidate netlists live in a TemporaryDirectory owned by the tuning run and are removed when tuning returns

adaptive_max_step.source: config/inputs/<vendor>.yaml#dpt.max_step; local://unified_rom_spec.md section 3.3 (EPC 100 ns cap on both arms)

eps_rule.rationale: per-table widths: q_oss for the Qoss Vds chain, transfer_vgs for the channel Vgs amp/sat ramps; transfer_vds is the Vds-grid diagnostic (the tanh knee is fitted, not a Vds ramp)

tier2_fallbacks.rationale: inherited from the closed Tier-2 emitter; gate-cap equivalents are evaluated at Cap_ref_Vds so the 4.5 nF / 7.5 pF / 1.5 Ohm fallbacks are not selected

gate_charge_tables.source: curve4 c_eq_charge*3 / c_eq_energy*0.15 on the curve-4 Vds grid
gate_charge_tables.rationale: closed Tier-2 linear gate-side scalar, tabulated so apply_scalars can add O_GD*V without a hidden fallback

c1.c0_ab_note: A/B against canonical build_tier2_subcircuit(c1_eps=None) at the same UROM subckt name
